record.question:
A power BJT is used as a power control switch by biasing it in the cut off region (off state) or in the
saturation region (on state). In the on state —
options: both the base-emitter & base-collector junctions are forward biased
the base-emitter junction is reverse biased, and the base collector junction is forward biased
_ the base-emitter junction is forward biased, and the base collector junction is reversed biased
_ both the base-collector & the base-emitter junctions are reversed biased
record.direction: Follow the printed paper instructions and option order. The source image retains formulas, tables and shared directions.
